reviewed_matched_routes.finding: The two canonical direct S3 rows exercise different current-control disturbances and evidence surfaces. Multi-Agent Orchestration uses a 54-scenario deterministic supervisor on/off ablation with MockProvider and completion/routing metrics, while Omnigent supplies descriptive operational/regression evidence for parent-runner interruption and child-session recovery at a later post-assessment revision. They do not share a benchmark, model/configuration cell, disturbance, intervention, evaluator or metric protocol.

Astra holds model, tools and workload largely fixed across framework rows, but its Agno and AutoGen configurations do not activate the canonical S3 paths used by the Index assessments: Agno is evaluated through TeamMode.coordinate rather than TeamMode.tasks, and AutoGen through SelectorGroupChat rather than MagenticOneOrchestrator. The matched framework cell therefore cannot be promoted to matched canonical S3 capability.

SupervisorAgent / SMAS publishes a direct base-versus-supervised current-control result, but the S3 relation belongs to the composed supervised-MAS boundary rather than the wrapped base harness. Its intervention repertoire also includes verification-like actions, so the row is not an isolated native canonical S3 comparison.

These public benchmark families directly study manager/current-control authority, failure or recovery at benchmark-defined organizations. The reviewed evidence does not bind one common result cell to two or more canonical harnesses exercising their own native or adapter-preserved S3 paths.

blocking_reason: Two canonical direct S3 observations now exist, but Multi-Agent Orchestration and Omnigent are materially heterogeneous public evidence surfaces. No reviewed public benchmark currently evaluates two or more canonical systems under one matched current-control disturbance/intervention definition while preserving each system's native or adapter-preserved S3 path.
reopen_when: a public benchmark publishes recoverable results for at least two canonical systems under one materially matched S3 current-control disturbance/intervention definition while exercising native or adapter-preserved S3 paths
an existing canonical direct S3 observation gains a second materially comparable canonical row through already-public upstream evidence
an existing matched framework campaign publishes configuration or trace evidence proving that canonical S3 paths are active for multiple compared systems under one recoverable protocol
do_not_reopen_for: another heterogeneous descriptive canonical S3 observation
another composed or benchmark-scaffolded supervisor result without canonical native or adapter-preserved linkage
another whole-task quality, token, latency or orchestration score without isolated current-control attribution
an Opensiro-operated reproduction or harness benchmark run
non_claim: This search closure does not score S3 capability, compare Multi-Agent Orchestration against Omnigent, or imply that either canonical system is stronger. It records only the absence of a materially matched public canonical S3 comparison cell at the reviewed evidence boundary.
